items.title: KKR Banks Line Up €550 Million of Debt to Back Logoplaste Buyout
items.description: Banks have lined up €550 million ($603.5 million) of loans to back KKR & Co.’s acquisition of packaging company Logoplaste, according to people familiar with the situation.

items.title: Stellantis to Pause More Europe Plants as Chinese Rivals Advance
items.description: Stellantis NV is planning further plant stoppages in Europe in the coming weeks as the carmaker grapples with mounting competition, high costs and weak demand for some models.

items.title: Trans-Oil Warns of Going-Concern Risk Pending Debt Waiver
items.description: Trans-Oil Group has yet to secure a waiver after breaching financial covenants on a key export facility, adding to liquidity pressure at the agricultural commodities firm.

items.title: Wall Street se vuelve más cauteloso con el carry trade
items.description: La operación llegó a generar retornos cercanos a 20% y resistió guerras, intervenciones y crisis políticas. Ahora, la volatilidad obliga a repensar una de las maniobras favoritas del mercado.

items.title: Congo Gold Trader Plans Two Refineries with 68-Ton Capacity
items.description: Democratic Republic of Congo’s state gold trader plans to build two refineries with capacity for 68 tons as the country looks to curb smuggling and profit more from its reserves of the precious metal.

items.title: Bawag’s €1.6 Billion PTSB Deal Rejected by Irish High Court
items.description: The Irish High Court declined to approve Bawag Group AG’s takeover of Irish lender Permanent TSB Group Holdings Plc, saying that the Austrian bank must also seek approval of minority shareholders.
